title: Measured panel 40 mm narrower than declared
rationale: The robot measures a 2400 x 1220 mm panel for a job declared on 2440 x 1220: Hausdorff distance 40 mm, above tol_panel = 25 mm (safety-model 12, step 3), so no hypothesis passes. The design's case list says 25 mm narrower, which is exactly tol_panel and passes under 'at most tol_panel': the case uses 40 mm.
